snippet.title: Freelance AI Engineer: Clients Kis Kaam Ke Paise Dete Hain? (Urdu/Hindi)
snippet.description:
Freelance engineering mein clients kis kaam ke liye hire karte hain? Is Urdu/Hindi tutorial mein contracts, defined projects, business automation, assistants, delivery aur maintenance retainers ko visual examples ke saath samajhiye.

Topics: team contracts versus project outcomes; technical and business buyers; back-office automation; assistants and MCP connections; project examples; working alongside employment; support and retainers.

Practical AI workflows: https://withhammad.com/

Presented with my AI avatar and cloned voice. The short intro and first two narration chapters reuse existing generated assets. Remaining narration uses a local voice-cloning model. Slides and narration are original; project categories are illustrative, not claims about my own clients or earnings.

Reference: What Companies Hire Freelance Engineers For in 2026, Dave Ebbelaar — https://youtu.be/1HtydHmdhrQ

#Freelancing #AIEngineering #Automation

CHAPTERS
0:00 What clients hire you for
0:18 Contracts versus projects
3:26 Engineering teams and business buyers
6:30 Business automation and assistants
9:50 Delivery and project examples
13:09 Contracts, retainers and next steps
